name: Prongscreen
description: Walk forward with the sai held crossways so a qi-stiffened guard travels with every pace.

name: Keen Handknob
description: Pivot on the lead heel and send the jab back along its own line before the foe resets.

name: Fleet Sidehook
description: Slipping sideways under a swing the tines catch behind the opponent's knee as the body passes.

name: Sturdy Crossprong
description: Step in a small circle while the fork meets each cut so the guard never stands still.

name: Dense Tineleft
description: Drag the rear foot up as the sai drops across the belly to cover a closing step.

name: Pinionglide
description: Roll the tines along the opponent's blade to enter close and land the butt-knob on the ribs.

name: Wristflog
description: Throw the full weight of a forward step down the shaft so the central prong punches through a guard.

name: Clutching Hiltpoint
description: Set qi in both wrists and close the tines on a descending blade before it finishes its cut.

name: Gripping Tinecrook
description: Press the flat of the fork down on a trapped blade until it pins against the ground.

name: Wrestbuckle
description: A side tine hooks the guard of a sword and draws the weapon off its line.

name: Grim Twist
description: Release a trap by snapping the butt-knob up into the opponent's elbow.

name: Rooted Sanguard
description: While one sai holds a blade the other crosses low to cover the holder's ribs.

name: Attentive Tineright
description: Feel through the held blade how the opponent shifts weight and where the arm tires.

name: Binding Centerprong
description: Lock a blade in both tines and turn the sai a full quarter so its edge slews toward the opponent's own body.

name: Twisthasp
description: With a burst of qi through both wrists the trapped blade is wrenched clean out of the hand.

name: Handknob Screen
description: Roll the wrist over when the opponent crowds in so the tines shed the push sideways.

name: Snagthwack
description: Bump the shoulder into a crowding opponent to open the gap a sai needs to swing.

name: Padded Sidehook
description: Change grip behind a held guard so the sai never leaves the line of a pressing blade.

name: Clasphurdle
description: Pivot on the heel and pull the hips out of a bear hug while the sai stays raised.

name: Resolute Tineright
description: Spin the sai in a tight loop between the tines and the forearm so a hard push is shed round the body.

name: Prongslap
description: Squeeze the fork against the opponent's blade and use the rebound to snap the butt-knob across the jaw.

name: Entangling Wrest
description: Wedge the central prong between the opponent's fingers and the hilt to loosen the grip.

name: Clasphasp
description: Hook a side tine under the hilt guard and peel the weapon upward and away.

name: Stubborn Tineleft
description: Cover the wrist with the crossbar so the opponent cannot snap back for a cut.

name: Lassoing Clasp
description: Take a staff between the tines and twist so the wood binds against the shaft.

name: Stalling Snag
description: Strip a lifted weapon from a hand with the off sai while the other stays on guard.

name: Wild Hiltpoint
description: Flick the taken weapon away with the yoke and rap the empty hand for good measure.

name: Cramping Crossprong
description: Wedge the prong and hook both tines in one motion so that qi pulls the weapon free of any grip.

name: Levering Handknob
description: Spin the yoke around a spear shaft and carry it down in a long arc that leaves the hands empty.

name: Veeswat
description: Turn a seized blade back on its owner by driving the tines along its flat into the shoulder.

name: Firm Handknob
description: Send a short pulse of qi through the sai at the instant of contact and stop the blow cold.

name: Armored Sanguard
description: Meet a hammering overhead cut with the crossbar braced and the knees bent to take the weight.

name: Draught Hiltpoint
description: Check a slashing blade by sliding the tines up its edge and holding it away from the throat.

name: Layered Crossprong
description: Rise from a crouch with the sai crossed so a low swing is lifted over the head.

name: Brasstwist
description: Use the rebound of a blocked edge to carry the butt-knob into the opponent's wrist.

name: Clayprong
description: Set both feet a shoulder apart and brace the sai against a charge from a heavy weapon.

name: Candor Tineleft
description: Count the beat between blows through the sai so the next block comes just before the strike.

name: Veebarrier
description: Meter qi into the crossed sai in rising steps so a long barrage is met by a guard that tightens with each blow.

name: Hum Tinecrook
description: The fork gives back an inch under a heavy blow and a qi pulse throws the blade high.

name: Shard Prongbase
description: Turn a perfect block into a forward thrust so the prong follows the push of the blow back.

name: Ember Sidehook
description: Jam the yoke up under the chin of a grappling opponent and drive the head back.

name: Wristswat
description: Hammer the butt-knob into the inner thigh from a clinch where no point can swing.

name: Splice Tineleft
description: Hook a tine over the opponent's arm in a clinch and hold it pinned against the ribs.

name: Grit Handknob
description: Check the hip against the opponent's thigh and slip a half step round to the flank.

name: Discord Clasp
description: Fork the collar and drag downward so the opponent's head drops into the next blow.

name: Wristbuckle
description: Hold the sai close along the ribs as a rail so a hooking cut finds only metal.

name: Burdening Wrest
description: A sudden twist of both tines against the thumb of a grip breaks the hold with a pulse of qi.

name: Staticsnag
description: Rap knob and yoke and knob again against the same ribs faster than a guard can drop.

name: Rushing Snag
description: Hurl the sai overhand at short range so the central prong flies point-first at the chest.

name: Gleam Pinion
description: Lob the sai underhand low across the ground to take an advancing opponent at the shins.

name: Rill Prongbase
description: Draw a second sai from the sash and use it at once to turn aside a counter cut.

name: Clay Hiltpoint
description: Plant the feet side-on with weight loaded behind the arm before the throw leaves the hand.

name: Gapwrist
description: Judge the spin and the range from the weight of the sai before it is thrown.

name: Poise Sanguard
description: A thread of qi left in the hurled sai lets the hand sense it and call it back into the grip.

name: Twistthwack
description: Hurl the sai spinning end over end so the tines rake the target and the butt-knob batters it.

name: Harsh Tineleft
description: Parry with the lead sai and jab with the rear in a single pass along one line.

name: Sleet Crossprong
description: Cross both arms in front of the chest as the sai come up to cover a diagonal cut.

name: Gagging Centerprong
description: Hook with the left tine and then the right to drag a weapon arm across the body.

name: Unmoving Handknob
description: Block a big swing from the outside with both sai set one behind the other.

name: Brawn Sidehook
description: Advance on alternate feet in time with the alternate sai so neither hand lags behind.

name: Prongscorer
description: Pass the work from one sai to the other mid-swing so the blow seems to come from nowhere.

name: Woven Hiltpoint
description: Bind a blade with one sai then strike with the other and weave back into the bind without a break.

name: Stamp Prongbase
description: Pincer a weapon between the tines of both sai and jab the freed prong through the gap.

name: Honedclasp
description: Drop the butt-knobs alternately in a falling rhythm that stiffens with qi at every third rap.
